experiment.title: Typed five-term shared-sign source-state operator
experiment.objective: Measure whether a paired affine addition primitive reduces the charged source-state cost of the exact source-orbit quotient.

inputs.operator: paired affine P+S/P-S with shared denominator inversion

stopping_rules: charge paired fallback and source cache work
do not promote field-only savings to a net result without inversions and memory
invalidation_rules: invalidate on any paired arithmetic mismatch
do not treat sub-full failure as full solver failure
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidate if clean verifier or rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: Full controls pass and paired source-state cost is below both committed comparators; a stronger positive also requires a two-curve sub-full support/held-out/rank gate.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Any full arithmetic mismatch, no source-cost improvement after complete charging, or no accepted sub-full class budget.
